user.title: Welcome to SlotSentry

locks.title: Select Locks

slot_count.title: Slot Count
slot_count.description:
SlotSentry could not auto-detect the number of code slots on your locks. Please enter the slot count manually. Check your lock documentation if unsure — most residential Z-Wave locks have 19 or 30 slots.

* Required field

lock_code_lengths.title: Code Lengths Per Lock
lock_code_lengths.description:
Select the PIN code length for each lock. If all locks use the same length, SlotSentry uses single-code mode. If you select two different lengths, dual-code mode is enabled automatically.

Maximum of 2 distinct code lengths are supported.

* Required field

seed.title: Seed From Existing Lock — Optional
seed.description:
SlotSentry can read existing PIN codes from a lock and use them as a starting point. Only locks that support full code readback are shown below.

Select a lock to seed from, or leave as "None" to start with empty slots. Codes will be read and filled into sequential slot numbers, collapsing any gaps.

lockout.title: Keypad Lockout — Optional
lockout.description:
SlotSentry can disable lock keypads when a trigger entity reaches one or more target states (e.g. when your alarm is armed).

Select the trigger entity, then choose which states activate the lockout. You can select multiple states or type custom values.

If lockout is enabled, a trigger entity and at least one target state are required.

data.lockout_target_states: Target states (lockout activates when entity matches any)

secure_mode.title: Secure Mode — Optional
secure_mode.description:
When Secure Mode is enabled, all stored PIN codes are encrypted at rest using a password you choose. You will need this password every time you open the SlotSentry panel.

If you enable Secure Mode, enter and confirm your password below. Secure Mode can also be changed later via Reconfigure.

confirm.title: Review & Confirm

reconfig_locks.title: Reconfigure — Lock Selection
reconfig_locks.description:
Add or remove locks from the managed set. Code lengths and slot count cannot be changed here — delete and re-add the integration to change those.

Slot count will only increase if a newly added lock has more slots than the current count.

reconfig_lockout.title: Reconfigure — Keypad Lockout
reconfig_lockout.description: Configure or disable keypad lockout. Enable the toggle and fill all fields to activate lockout, or leave the toggle off to disable it.

data.lockout_target_states: Target states (lockout activates when entity matches any)

reconfig_secure.title: Reconfigure — Secure Mode
reconfig_secure.description: Enable or disable Secure Mode for PIN code encryption at rest. If enabling, enter and confirm your password below.

reconfig_confirm.title: Review Changes
reconfig_confirm.description:
{changes_summary}

Click Submit to apply these changes. The integration will reload automatically.
